title: ReportResponse
description: Response object containing report data rows and pagination information. The Report_Entry array contains objects whose properties correspond to the report columns configured in Workday.

items.description: A single report row. Properties vary based on the report columns configured in the Workday report definition.

Report_Has_More_Rows.description: Indicates whether additional rows are available beyond the current page for pagination

Report_Total_Rows.description: Total number of rows matching the report filter criteria
